title: 高层建筑
summary: 高层建筑指供人长期停留、最高楼层在建筑一侧高出地面 > 22 m 的建筑；高度 ≤ 60 m 的高层须至少设两部相对布置、位于两个不同防火分区的疏散楼梯，其通行宽度须 ≥ 1.25 m（例外情况下可批准仅设一部安全楼梯）。
question: According to the German high-rise building regulations: (a) above what height of the uppermost floor (on one side of the building, above ground level) does a building intended for long-term human occupation count as a high-rise building, and (b) what minimum walking width must each of the emergency stairs have in a high-rise building up to 60 m high?
answer: (a) more than 22 m; (b) at least 1.25 m
rubric: High-rise threshold: uppermost floor more than 22 m above ground on one side
Emergency stair walking width min. 1.25 m (high-rise up to 60 m, at least two stairs in separate fire compartments)

basis.quote: High-rise buildings are those intended for long-term human occupation whose upper-most floor on one side of the building is more than 22 m above ground level.
High-rise buildings up to 60 m high: at least two emergency stairs must be available, which must be located opposite in two separate fire compartments. Their walking width must be at least 1.25 m.

title: 退距（Abstandsfläche）
summary: 按示范建筑条例（MBO），退距深度为 0.4 H 且不小于 3 m（商业区和工业区为 0.2 H，不小于 3 m）；建筑等级 1 和 2、地上不超过三层的建筑外墙前，3 m 深度即足够；各州 LBO 规定不同并有其他例外。墙高 H 自地面量至墙顶或墙与屋面覆盖层交线，垂直于墙面测量；坡度 ≤ 70° 的屋面高度按 1/3 计入、≥ 70° 全部计入。退距须位于本地块内（也可延伸至公共交通、绿地或水域的中线，或延伸至依公法确定不可建造的其他地块）。檐口、挑檐等外墙突出构件若占墙宽合计 < 1/3、外挑 ≤ 1.50 m 且距对面地界 ≥ 2 m，则不计入退距。
question: According to the German model building regulations (MBO), what is the general rule for the required depth of the setback area (Abstandsfläche) in front of an external wall of height H, in general areas (i.e. not commercial or industrial areas)?
answer: 0.4 × H, but at least 3 m
accept: 0.4 H with a minimum of 3 m
40% of wall height, not less than 3 m
rubric: (Optional) 0.2 × H applies only to commercial/industrial areas

basis.quote: The depth of setback areas differs in the various state building regulations (LBO)). According to the model building regulations (MBO), it is 0.4 × H, but at least 3 m (0.2 × H, min. 3 m for commercial and industrial areas). In front of the outside walls of building classes 1 and 2 with not more than three overground storeys, 3 m depth is also sufficient.
According to the model building regulations (MBO), it is 0.4 × H, but at least 3 m (0.2 × H, min. 3 m for commercial and industrial areas).

title: 建筑密度与容积率
summary: 土地利用条例规定的规划法建设用途度量参数：建筑密度（plot coverage ratio）为可允许的建成面积占地块面积之比，建成面积包括建筑平面面积及车库、停车位及其通道、附属面积和地块下方的地下设施；容积率（floor-area ratio）为可允许的楼层面积（所有完整楼层外轮廓尺寸，不含附属面积、阳台、凉廊、露台及允许建在退距内的构筑物）与地块面积之比。
question: Under the German land use regulation (measures of building use in planning law), the floor-area ratio (GFZ) is the permissible ratio of storey area to plot area. How is the storey area determined, and are balconies, loggias and terraces included?
answer: External dimensions of all full storeys; balconies, loggias and terraces (and subsidiary areas, structures permissible in setback areas) are excluded
accept: gross external area of all full floors excluding balconies, loggias and terraces
outer dimensions of full storeys, without balconies/loggias/terraces

options: Net internal floor area of all storeys, including balconies and loggias
External dimensions of all full storeys, excluding balconies, loggias and terraces
External dimensions of all storeys including basements, balconies and terraces
Ground-floor footprint only, including garages and their access

rubric: Storey area measured to external dimensions of all full floors
Balconies, loggias, terraces (and subsidiary areas) not counted

basis.quote: the floor-area ratio (determines the permissible ratio of storey area (external dimensions of all full floors, without subsidiary areas..., balconies, loggias, terraces and structures which are permissible inside setback areas) to the plot area.

title: DIN 277 面积分类与可出租面积
summary: 毛面积按外轮廓计算，结构面积是墙柱所占面积，净面积是构件之间的面积，再分为使用、技术和交通面积；可出租面积（GIF）不含楼梯、电梯、紧急出口、设备间和管井。
question: According to DIN 277, the net floor area is the sum of which three area categories?
answer: Usable area, technical function area and traffic (circulation) area

options: Usable area, technical function area and traffic area
Usable area, constructional area and traffic area
Gross area, constructional area and usable area
Letting area, communal area and traffic area

basis.quote: The net floor area is the sum of the usable area (area which serves the building’s intended purpose), the technical function area (rooms for building services, such as utility connection room, accessible shafts, etc.) and the traffic area (e.g. stairwells, corridors, lift shafts, escape balconies etc.).

title: DIN 277 建筑体积（总体积与净体积）
summary: 按 DIN 277，总建筑体积为各层楼面面积乘以相应高度（自本层地面面层顶量至上层地面面层顶），净建筑体积为净面积乘以相应的室内净高。
question: According to DIN 277, the gross built volume is the sum of the floor areas of all levels multiplied by the relevant height. Between which surfaces is that height measured?
answer: From the top of the floor covering to the top of the floor covering of the next level

options: From the top of the floor covering to the underside of the ceiling
From the top of the structural slab to the underside of the suspended ceiling
From the underside of one structural slab to the underside of the next
From the top of the floor covering to the top of the floor covering of the next level

rubric: Top of floor covering to top of floor covering of next level
(Net built volume = net floor area × clear ceiling height)

basis.quote: The gross built volume is the sum of the floor areas of all levels multiplied by the relevant height (measured between top of floor covering and top of floor covering of the next level

title: 联排住宅进深 ≤12 m、面宽 4–8 m
summary: 联排住宅只能从两个立面直接采光，经济进深不超过 12 m、面宽 4–8 m，中部不可避免地形成布置楼梯、辅助房间（常含就餐区）的暗区。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Terraced (row) houses can receive direct daylight only from two façades. What economic building depth (maximum) and what range of house widths typically apply to row houses, which make a badly lit middle zone (stairs, subsidiary rooms) unavoidable?
answer: Depth up to 12 m; width 4–8 m

options: Depth up to 10 m; width 5–7 m
Depth up to 12 m; width 4–8 m
Depth up to 15 m; width 6–10 m
Depth up to 12 m; width 8–12 m

basis.quote: Building in a row restricts the possibilities for direct lighting to two façades so that, with economic building depths of up to 12 m and widths between 4 and 8 m, the existence of a badly lit or dark middle zone containing the stairs, subsidiary rooms and often also the dining area becomes unavoidable.

title: 建筑进深与采光深度
summary: 中廊式办公楼通常进深 12–13 m；自然采光大约能利用到 7.00 m 的房间进深。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: What is the usual building depth of office buildings with central corridors, and to about what room depth can daylight mostly be exploited?
answer: 12–13 m building depth; daylight to about 7.00 m room depth
rubric: Daylight usable to about 7.00 m room depth

basis.quote: The usual depth of buildings with central corridors is 12–13 m.
Daylight can mostly be exploited into a room depth of about 7.00 m.

title: 装修网格与立面网格一致
summary: 装修（隔墙）网格与立面网格必须一致，隔墙才能接到窗上；结构网格可以与装修网格错开，这样减少隔墙与柱的连接问题，但有柱的房间会损失面积。因各类构件寿命不同，应选用可适应调整的模数。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: Which two planning grids of an office building must coincide so that partitions can connect to the windows, and which grid may be offset against them?
answer: The fit-out (partition) grid and the façade grid must be the same; the structural grid can be offset against the fit-out grid
accept: fit-out grid = façade grid; structural grid may be offset
partition grid and facade grid identical, structural grid offset

options: All three grids must always coincide
Fit-out grid and façade grid must coincide; the structural grid may be offset
Structural grid and fit-out grid must coincide; the façade grid may be offset
Structural grid and façade grid must coincide; the fit-out grid may be offset

rubric: Fit-out grid and façade grid must be the same
Structural grid can be offset against the fit-out grid

basis.quote: The fitting out and façade grids must be the same in order to enable the partitions to connect to the windows.
The structural grid can be offset against the fitting out grid. This reduces the problem of connecting the partitions to columns, but loses space in the rooms, which contain columns.

title: 网格模数与建筑进深的搭配
summary: 网格 1.35 m、建筑进深 13.40 m 是组合式办公的经济形式，但用于单间办公时房间过深、比例差；网格 1.50 m、建筑进深 12.50 m 对单间办公或组合式办公都经济，但公共区较窄，靠窗工位比前者少 10%。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: What building depth goes with a 1.35 m grid module as the economical form for combi-offices, and what building depth goes with a 1.50 m grid module (economical for single offices or combi-offices)?
answer: 13.40 m with the 1.35 m module; 12.50 m with the 1.50 m module

basis.quote: Grid module 1.35 m, building depth 13.40 m, an economical form of building for combi-offices, but for single offices this produces deep and badly proportioned rooms.

Grid module 1.50 m, building depth 12.50 m, an economical form of building for single offices or for combi-offices; this provides a narrow communal zone and 10% fewer workstations at the window than with ②.

title: 单排、双排与三排布局
summary: 单排布局不经济、不生态，只有办公室很深时才可接受；双排布局是行政办公楼至今最常用的形式，单间和小办公室都能有自然采光；三排布局（中部设大的服务核心区）通常只对高层建筑合适，其中部可用采光井自然采光。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: Among single-row, two-row and three-row office layouts, which is described as normally practical only for high-rise buildings, and why?
answer: The three-row layout with a large supply zone at the centre of the building, because of the greater proportion of vertical transport in high-rise buildings
accept: three-row layout (central supply core), due to the greater share of vertical transport

options: The layout without corridor, because it saves circulation area
The two-row layout, because the cores sit in well-lit zones
The three-row layout, because of the greater proportion of vertical transport
The single-row layout, because it gives every room daylight

rubric: Three-row layout / large central supply zone
Reason: greater proportion of vertical transport in high-rise buildings

basis.quote: A large supply zone at the centre of the building is normally practical only for high-rise buildings (greater proportion of vertical transport).

title: 可逆办公楼（出租办公）
summary: 可逆办公（Revibüro）其实不是一种办公室类型，而是一种建筑形式；适应性越高设备成本越高，办公室大小和组织上须接受折中；主要适合出租给尚未确定的租户。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: For what kind of occupier is a 'reversible office' building (Revibüro) mainly suitable?
answer: Offices for renting to tenants who are not yet known
accept: rental offices for unknown future tenants

options: A single owner-occupier with fixed staff numbers
Offices let to tenants who are not yet known

rubric: Rental to tenants not yet known

basis.quote: This type of building is mainly suitable for offices for renting to tenants who are not yet known

title: 每工位面积指标（直接工位与交通面积）
summary: 每个工位的平均毛面积指标：直接工位面积 11–15 m²（平均 13 m²），附加面积（洽谈、存放）1.5–4.2 m²（平均 2.5 m²），交通面积 2.2–6.0 m²（平均 4.5 m²）。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: In the average gross space requirement per office workstation, what range (and average) is given for (a) the immediate workstation and (b) the traffic area?
answer: (a) 11–15 m², average 13 m²; (b) 2.2–6.0 m², average 4.5 m²
accept: immediate workstation 11-15 m2; traffic area 2.2-6.0 m2

basis.quote: Workstation | Immediate workstation | 11–15 | 13 | 15.5
Traffic area | 2.2–6.0 | 4.5

title: 全空调对建筑体积的影响
summary: 全空调建筑的总建筑体积和总建造成本是无空调建筑的 1.3–1.5 倍。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: By what factor are the gross built volume and the total construction costs of a fully air-conditioned office building higher than for a building without air conditioning?
answer: 1.3–1.5 times

basis.quote: The gross built volume and the total construction costs for air-conditioned buildings are 1.3–1.5 times higher than for buildings without air conditioning

title: 高层建筑的分级
summary: 高层建筑按距消防车停放面的高度分级：I 级 22–30 m，适用高层建筑规定；II 级 30–60 m，至少 1 部消防电梯；III 级 60–200 m，结构重要构件须为 F 120，并可要求多部消防电梯；IV 级 200 m 以上，审批机关可提出进一步要求。
question: In the German classification of high-rise buildings by height above the fire service parking area, what height range is group II and what special requirement applies to it, and what must elements of structural significance achieve in group III (60–200 m)?
answer: Group II: 30–60 m, at least 1 fire service lift; group III: elements of structural significance must be F 120
accept: 30–60 m with one fire service lift; F 120

options: 60–100 m, at least 1 fire service lift; F 120
30–60 m, at least 1 fire service lift; F 120

rubric: Group III: structurally significant elements F 120

basis.quote: II | 30–60 m | at least 1 fire service lift
III | 60–200 m | elements of structural significance must be F 120 and many fire service lifts can be required

title: 高层建筑的用途限制
summary: 在德国，按现行法规高层建筑不得用作学校、医院或养老院。
question: In Germany, which uses are ruled out for high-rise buildings by the applicable regulations?
answer: Schools, hospitals and homes for elderly people

options: Schools, hospitals and homes for elderly people

basis.quote: In Germany, use as schools, hospitals or homes for elderly people is ruled out by the applicable regulations.

title: 舒适步距公式
summary: 踏步高 r 与踏面宽 t 应满足 2r + t = 59–65 cm（成人步距）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For a comfortable stair with the lowest energy requirement, a standard design rule combines riser height r and tread depth t, based on the stride length of an adult. Within what range should 2r + t lie?

basis.quote: In order to determine a suitable pitch with the lowest energy requirement, this formula applies: 2 r + t = 59–65 cm.

title: 最佳坡度与踏步比
summary: 最省力的是 30° 坡度、踏步比 17/29。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: From a physiological point of view, at what stair pitch and what riser-to-tread ratio (r/t, in cm) is 'climbing effort' generally considered to be used best?
answer: 30° pitch, riser/tread 17/29

basis.quote: the best use of 'climbing effort' is at a stair pitch of 30° and a ratio of riser (r) to tread (t) of 17/29.

title: 每段梯段步数
summary: 必要楼梯每段 3–18 步；18 步上限是“应当”性规定。
question: Under German stair rules, what is the permitted range for the number of steps in one run (flight) of a legally essential stair (one required as a fire escape route)?
answer: At least 3 and at most 18 steps per run (the 18-step limit is a 'should' rule)

basis.quote: Length of runs on legally essential stairs is \( \geq 3 \) steps up to \( \leq 18 \) steps
The 18-step rule is a 'should' regulation.

title: 休息平台
summary: 层高 ≥ 2.75 m 的必要楼梯必须设休息平台；平台长度 = n × 步距 + 1 个踏面。
question: Under German stair rules, from what storey height onwards must a legally essential stairway be provided with a landing (i.e. not be a single uninterrupted flight)?
answer: Storey height ≥ 2.75 m
accept: storey heights of 2.75 m or more
rubric: Landing required at storey height ≥ 2.75 m for legally essential stairs

basis.quote: Stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways with a storey height of \( \geq 2.75 \) m.

title: 必要楼梯宽度与踏步比
summary: 按德国标准（住宅建筑），法定必要楼梯（作为疏散路线）的可用梯宽至少 1.00 m、踏步比 17/28；对比：不超过两户的住宅楼梯可用宽度至少 0.80 m（17/28），非必要楼梯 0.50 m（21/21），高层住宅 1.25 m。
question: According to German standards, what minimum usable stair width and riser/tread ratio apply to legally essential stairs (fire escape routes) in residential buildings that are neither houses with at most two flats nor high-rise flats?
answer: 1.00 m usable width, riser/tread 17/28

basis.quote: legally essential stairs 1.00 m, 17/28

title: 两户以下住宅的楼梯
summary: 按德国标准，不超过两户的住宅，楼梯须满足可用宽度至少 0.80 m、踏步比（踢面/踏面）17/28；（同段：非法定必要楼梯可为 0.50 m、21/21，其他法定必要楼梯 1.00 m、17/28，高层住宅 1.25 m）。
question: According to German standards, what minimum usable stair width and riser/tread ratio must stairs have in residential buildings with no more than two flats?
answer: 0.80 m usable width, riser/tread 17/28

basis.quote: residential buildings with no more than two flats must have a usable stair width min. 0.80 m, 17/28 riser to tread ratio

title: 室外楼梯与办公楼梯的取向
summary: 室外楼梯宜用低踏步（12×41 至 16×30 cm）；办公楼梯和疏散楼梯应便于快速通行。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Low steps are generally recommended for outside stairs. What range of step dimensions (riser × tread) is considered preferable for outside stairs?
answer: From 12 × 41 cm to 16 × 30 cm
rubric: Range 12 × 41 cm to 16 × 30 cm (low steps preferable outdoors)

basis.quote: For outside stairs, low steps are preferable, with dimensions of 12 × 41 to 16 × 30 cm.

title: 螺旋楼梯
summary: 螺旋楼梯作为住宅内唯一的连接楼梯，直径 ≥ 190 cm、可用宽度 80 cm。
question: In German (DIN-based) stair design guidance, what minimum diameter must a spiral staircase have to be permissible as the sole connecting stair inside a house, and what usable walking width is associated with it?
answer: Diameter from 190 cm, with 80 cm usable walking width
accept: 1.90 m diameter and 0.80 m walking width

basis.quote: Spiral staircases are permissible from 190 cm in diameter as the sole connecting stairs inside houses with 80 cm usable walking width

title: 楼座、夹层、阳台的护栏高度
summary: 楼座、夹层、阳台及剧院楼座看台须设护栏（高 h），高差 ≥ 1 m 起强制：坠落高度 < 12 m 时 h = 0.90 m；坠落高度 > 12 m 时 h = 1.10 m；工作场所坠落高度 < 12 m 时 h = 1.00 m，且楼梯井宽至少 20 cm 时，坠落高度超过 12 m 也为 1.00 m（同一正文条目所述）。
question: Under German (DIN-based) building guidance, galleries, mezzanines and balconies must have a protective guard rail once the height difference reaches a certain value. For a non-workplace building, what guard rail height h is required (a) for a drop of less than 12 m and (b) for a drop of more than 12 m?
rubric: (Optional) workplaces: 1.00 m; compulsory from 1 m height difference

basis.quote: drop <12 m, h = 0.90 m
drop >12 m, h = 1.10 m

title: 无障碍坡道
summary: 坡道坡度 ≤ 6%、净宽 ≥ 1.20 m、两侧设扶手；起点、终点及每 6 m 设长度 ≥ 1.50 m 的平台（坡道长于 6 m 须设中间平台）。
question: For barrier-free design under German regulations, what are (a) the maximum slope of a ramp, (b) its minimum clear width, and (c) the ramp length beyond which an intermediate landing is required?
accept: max 6%, min 120 cm wide, landing every 6 m
rubric: Intermediate landing (min. 1.50 m long) every 6 m / when longer than 6 m

basis.quote: If ramps are longer than 6 m, an intermediate landing of min. 1.50 m length is required.
Ramps may not have a slope of more than 6%, must be at least 1.20 m wide and have a fixed handrail with a safe grip on both sides.
A landing is to be provided at the start and end of the ramp and also an intermediate landing every 6 m. The landings must have a length of at least 1.50 m.

title: 公共建筑楼梯两侧扶手
summary: 按 MBO §50，公众可达建筑的楼梯须两侧设扶手，扶手应在休息平台和窗洞处连续，并延伸过最后一级踏步。
question: Under the German model building regulations (MBO) provisions for publicly accessible buildings, on how many sides must stairs have handrails, and how must the handrails run at landings, window openings and the last step?
answer: On both sides, continued past landings and window openings and past the last steps
accept: both sides, continuous past landings, windows and beyond the last step

options: One side; continued past landings, window openings and the last steps
Both sides; interrupted at landings and window openings, ending at the last step
Both sides; continued past landings, window openings and the last steps
Both sides; interrupted at window openings, ending flush with the last step

rubric: Continued (not interrupted) past landings and window openings and beyond the last step

basis.quote: Stairs must have handrails on both sides, which are to be continued past landings and window openings and past the last steps.

title: 电梯候梯区
summary: 候梯（排队）空间不得占用楼梯；单台电梯前候梯区自井道门墙至对面墙的最小可用进深（沿轿厢进深方向量）应等于轿厢进深，最小可用面积应等于轿厢进深 × 井道宽度；无障碍电梯门前活动区不得与其他交通路线和活动区重叠。
question: According to German (DIN-based) lift planning guidance, what minimum usable depth should the waiting area in front of a single lift have, measured between the shaft door wall and the opposite wall in the direction of the car depth?
answer: Equal to the lift car depth

options: Equal to the lift car width
Equal to the lift car depth

rubric: (Optional) area = car depth × shaft width; waiting space must not infringe on stairs

basis.quote: minimum usable depth between shaft door wall and opposing wall, measured in the direction of the depth of the car, should equal the car depth

title: 非必要楼梯
summary: 按德国标准（书中在“不超过两户的住宅”一句中列出）：建筑法规不视为必要楼梯（不作为法定疏散路线）的楼梯，可用宽度（最小）0.50 m，踏步比 21/21；相比之下必要楼梯为 1.00 m、17/28。
question: According to German standards, what minimum usable width and riser/tread ratio apply to stairs that building regulations do not deem legally essential (i.e. not fire escape routes)?
answer: 0.50 m usable width, riser/tread 21/21

basis.quote: stairs not deemed by building regulations to be legally essential (as fire escape routes) 0.50 m, 21/21

title: 休息平台宽度不小于梯段宽度
summary: 楼梯休息平台宽度不小于楼梯宽度；（同一图注）层高 ≥ 2.75 m 的法定必要楼梯须设休息平台。
question: In German stair design rules, how must the width of a stair landing relate to the stair (flight) width?
answer: Landing width must be at least equal to the stair width (landing width ≥ stair width)
accept: at least as wide as the flight

options: At least 1.5 times the stair width
At least equal to the stair width
May be up to 20% narrower than the stair

title: 工位面积的构成
summary: 标准不再规定工位的固定尺寸，而要求有足够的工作面积和活动面积。面积分为：工作面（桌面）、搁置面（家具的平面面积）、家具功能面（门和抽屉开启所需）、工位活动面、交通与通行面；各类面积在不影响功能时可以重叠。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: The current standard no longer fixes workplace dimensions but distinguishes several kinds of area at a workstation. Name the five areas.
answer: Work area (table), shelf area (plan area of the furniture), furniture function area (space for doors and drawers), movement area at the workstation, and traffic and through-passages
accept: work area, shelf area, furniture function area, movement area, traffic/through-passage area

options: Work, storage, meeting, break and printing areas
Work, shelf, furniture function, movement, and traffic/through-passage areas
Net, gross, usable, technical and circulation areas
Desk, chair, screen, cabinet and lighting areas

basis.quote:
– work area: table
– shelf area: plan area of the furniture
– furniture function area: space required for doors and drawers
– movement area at the workstation
– traffic and through-passages

title: 屏幕工位与窗的关系
summary: 屏幕工位的视线方向应与窗立面及灯带平行，屏幕尽量位于两者之间。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: How should the direction of view to a computer screen be oriented relative to the window façade and the light bands?
answer: Parallel to the window façade and to the light bands, with the screen if possible in between
accept: parallel to the windows and the light bands

options: With the back to the window
Parallel to the window façade and light bands

rubric: View direction parallel to window façade and light bands

basis.quote: The view to the screen should be parallel to the window façade and to light bands, with the screen if possible in-between.

title: 档案存放的面积与位置
summary: 档案系统所需面积 = 家具面积 + 通道面积，其中家具面积 = 长 × 宽，通道面积 = ½ 长 × 宽 + 0.5 m；档案系统应设在中心位置；密集架（移动式档案系统）取消中间通道，可节省 100–120% 的空间。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: In the formula for the space needed by a filing system (filing furniture of length L and width W), how is the passage space calculated?
answer: ½ L × W + 0.5 m
accept: half of L × W plus 0.5 m
rubric: Passage space = ½ L × W + 0.5 m

basis.quote:
L × W (filing furniture) = space for furniture
+ ½ L × W + 0.5 m = passage space

title: 收发室
summary: 收发室负责全部进出邮件和货物的分发；工作位（打包台、分拣台）应足够大，以便高峰时快速分发；面积需求约每工位 0.3–0.5 m²。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: What space requirement is given for the post room of an office building?
answer: About 0.3–0.5 m² per work position

basis.quote: Space requirement – 0.3-0.5 m² per work position.

title: 数据中心与服务器机房
summary: 数据中心或服务器机房因安装量大，应设 70 cm 高的架空地板并设空调；门禁尤其重要；备份系统应尽量与数据中心分开，设在有防火保护的区域。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: What raised-floor height should data centres or server rooms have because of the large amount of installation?
answer: 70 cm

basis.quote: These rooms should have a 70 cm raised floor on account of the large amount of installation, and should be air-conditioned.

title: 住宅门的常规宽度
summary: 住宅中单扇门的净开启宽度：房门约 80 cm，浴室/WC 门约 70 cm，户门 ≥ 90 cm，入户大门最大 115 cm。
question: In German (DIN-based) dwelling planning, what are the usual clear widths of single-leaf doors in dwellings for (a) room doors, (b) bathroom/WC doors and (c) entrance doors to flats?
answer: (a) approx. 80 cm; (b) approx. 70 cm; (c) min. 90 cm

basis.quote: room doors      approx. 80 cm
bath, WC        approx. 70 cm

entrance doors
    to flats      min. 90 cm
front doors      up to 115 cm

title: 内门净高
summary: 内门净开启高度最小 2.10 m。
question: In German (DIN-based) building planning, what is the minimum clear opening height of internal doors?
answer: 210 cm
rubric: Minimum clear opening height 210 cm (225 cm is a 'better' value, not the minimum)

basis.quote:
clear opening height of internal doors
minimum	210 cm

title: 紧急出口的门型
summary: 紧急出口处不允许使用推拉门和旋转门，因为危险情况下它们可能堵塞出口；旋转门通行能力较低，高峰时门扇可折叠推到一侧（图示有带附加紧急出口的旋转门示例）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Which two door types are not permissible at emergency exits because they can block the exit in circumstances of danger?
answer: Sliding doors and revolving doors

options: Double-swing doors and outward-opening side-hung doors
Doors with panic hardware and glazed doors

basis.quote: Sliding doors and revolving doors are not permissible at emergency exits, which they can block in circumstances of danger.

title: 电梯入户的户门
summary: 按 MBO，经电梯到达的住户户门须有 90 cm 净开启宽度（供轮椅通行），此时门高宜 ≥ 2.10 m。
question: According to the German model building regulations (MBO), what clear opening width must the front doors of flats that are accessed by lifts have (for wheelchair access)?
answer: 90 cm
rubric: (Optional) door height should be at least 2.10 m

basis.quote: front doors of flats which are accessed by lifts must have a clear opening width of 90 cm (for wheelchair access). The door height in this case should be at least 2.10 m.

title: 无障碍门净宽
summary: 无障碍公共建筑中，门净通行宽度 ≥ 0.90 m；按 MBO §50，公众可达建筑须至少能经一个净开口宽度 ≥ 0.90 m 且无台阶的入口进入。
question: In barrier-free (accessible) building design per German guidance, what is the minimum clear passage width of doors?

basis.quote: Clear passage width of doors \( \geq 0.90 \) m
must be accessible through an entrance with a clear opening width of at least 0.90 m without steps.

title: 疏散窗
summary: 作为疏散路线的窗，净开口 ≥ 0.9 × 1.2 m，窗台高 ≤ 1.2 m。
question: Under German building regulations, if a window serves as an escape route, what minimum clear opening (width × height) must it have, and what maximum sill height above floor level?
answer: Clear opening at least 0.9 × 1.2 m; sill height max. 1.2 m

basis.quote: If the window serves as an escape route, it must have a clear opening of at least 0.9 × 1.2 m and a sill height of max. 1.2 m above floor level.

title: 出口宽度（按人数）
summary: 紧急出口宽度每 150 人 1.0 m（餐饮章节）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In planning guidance for restaurants and catering establishments, emergency exits must be 1.0 m wide per how many people using them?
answer: 150 people

basis.quote: Emergency exits 1.0 m wide per 150 people using them.

title: 疏散走廊侧墙 F 30
summary: 作为疏散路线侧墙的走廊墙须为阻燃构造（F 30）；其上的采光开口是 G 级玻璃的典型应用（仅在无更高防火要求处允许），此时玻璃下沿须离地 ≥ 1.80 m。非承重分隔墙可做成不同品质的龙骨隔墙。
question: Under German building regulations, (a) what fire resistance class must corridor walls have when they are the side walls of escape routes, and (b) if lighting openings with G-glazing are installed in such walls, what minimum height above floor level must the lower edge of the glass be?
answer: (a) F 30 (fire-retarding); (b) at least 1.80 m
rubric: G-glazing lower edge ≥ 1.80 m above floor

basis.quote: A typical area of application for G-glazing is the openings for lighting installed in corridor walls, which have to be constructed fire-retarding (F 30) as the side walls of escape routes. The lower edge of the glass must in this case be at least 1.80 m above floor level, so that in case of fire the corridor remains usable in the radiation shadow.

title: 高层建筑立面的层间防火
summary: 高层建筑每层须有高 ≥ 1 m 的 W 90 A 防火窗槛墙，或外挑 ≥ 1.5 m 的 W 90 A 水平构件；全玻璃（含双层）幕墙须特别审批并采用喷淋等措施防止火势窜层。
question: Under German fire-protection requirements for high-rise building façades, a W 90 A fire-resistant parapet (the 'fire spreading height') is used to stop fire spreading from one storey to the next. What minimum height must this parapet have?
answer: 1 m
rubric: May mention alternative: W 90 A horizontal projection of at least 1.5 m

basis.quote: In order to avoid fire spreading from one storey to the one above, there must be W 90 A fire-resistant parapets at least 1 m high (fire spreading height).
Alternatively, a W 90 A horizontal building element projecting at least 1.5 m from the façade can be provided.

title: 单层外墙与附加保温层
summary: 单层外墙在建筑物理上没有问题，但由于保温要求高，只能用高保温材料（如加气砌块）配专用保温砂浆和抹灰砌筑；因此单层墙加附加保温层（外保温或内保温）是常见的替代做法。保温层外侧因受热积聚和基层抗剪强度低而有开裂风险，因此这里采用网格增强的矿物抹灰（或聚合物改性抹灰）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Single-leaf external masonry walls without an additional insulation layer must meet high thermal insulation requirements. What materials does this restrict their construction to?
answer: Materials with high thermal insulation value (e.g. aerated blocks) laid with special thermally insulating mortars and plasters
accept: highly insulating blocks such as aerated concrete with insulating mortar and plaster

options: Dense solid clay bricks with standard mortar and lime plaster
Highly insulating blocks (e.g. aerated blocks) with special thermally insulating mortar and plaster
Any masonry unit, provided a mesh-reinforced render is applied

rubric: Special thermally insulated mortars and plasters
Hence single-leaf walls with added insulation layers are a common alternative

basis.quote: Single-leaf external walls → ① – ② are unproblematic regarding building physics, but on account of the high thermal insulation requirements can only be built with materials with high thermal insulation value (e.g. aerated blocks) and special thermally insulated mortars and plasters.
Single-leaf walls with additional insulation layers → ③ – ⑥ (external, internal insulation → Building physics, p. 471 ff.) are therefore a common alternative.

title: 夹心墙（双叶墙）的外叶与空气层
summary: 夹心墙由内侧承重叶墙和外侧非承重防护面层组成，外叶最小厚 90 mm，可做空气层、空气层加保温、满填保温或中间抹灰层；空气层宽度至少 40 mm、最多 150 mm。
question: In German masonry construction, for a two-leaf cavity wall with a non-load-bearing outer weather-protection leaf, what is the minimum thickness of the outer leaf, and what are the minimum and maximum widths of the air gap?
answer: Outer leaf min. 90 mm; air gap min. 40 mm, max. 150 mm

basis.quote: Cavity walls consist of an inner load-bearing wall and an outer non-load-bearing weather protection facing (minimum thickness 90 mm). They can be built with an air gap, with air gap and thermal insulation, with cavity-filling insulation and with intermediate plaster layer
The width of the air gap should be min. 40 mm (max. 150 mm).

title: 混凝土外墙必须附加保温
summary: 实心混凝土墙只有加设附加保温层才能用作外墙：外保温系统，或带夹心保温（可加背通风）的多叶构造；带夹心保温的双层钢筋混凝土墙常用作大尺寸外墙构件。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Can a solid concrete wall be used as an external wall without an additional thermal insulation layer?
answer: No; only with an additional thermal insulation layer (external insulation system, or multi-leaf construction with core insulation)

options: Yes, if the wall is at least 30 cm thick
No, only with an additional thermal insulation layer

rubric: Answer is no: additional insulation is required
Options: external thermal insulation system or multi-leaf construction with core insulation

basis.quote: Solid concrete walls can be used as external walls only with an additional thermal insulation layer. This can be as an external thermal insulation system → ① or as a multi-leaf construction (analogous to p. 75) with core insulation and possibly back-ventilation.
Solid concrete walls can be used as external walls only with an additional thermal insulation layer.

title: 背通风外挂层的空气间层
summary: 背通风可消除较不透汽外层的隔汽效应；板材类外挂层后的空气间层至少 20 mm，砖砌外层至少 40 mm。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In external walls with a rear-ventilated outer skin, what minimum air-gap width is required behind a panel-like outer skin, and behind a brickwork outer skin?
answer: Panel-like skin: min. 20 mm; brickwork skin: min. 40 mm

basis.quote: The rear ventilation of the skin removes the vapour barrier effect of the relatively vapour-sealed outer layers. The width of the air gap with panel-like external skin amounts to min. 20 mm, or for brickwork outer skin min. 40 mm.

title: 热阻与传热系数计算
summary: 单层热阻 R = d/λ（d 以 m 计）；总热阻 1/U = R_si + R + R_se，U 为其倒数；表面空气层热阻只能占 1/U 的有限比例。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: How is the thermal resistance R of a single building layer calculated, and how is the overall resistance 1/U of a building element composed?
answer: R = d/λ (d = layer thickness in m); 1/U = R_si + R + R_se

options: R = d·λ; U = R_si + R + R_se

rubric: R = d/λ with d in metres
1/U is the sum of internal surface resistance, layer resistances and external surface resistance

basis.quote: Thermal resistance R, unit m^2K/W [m^2hK/kcal] is a property of a layer: R = d/λ (d = layer thickness in m).

Overall resistance 1/U, unit m^2K/W [m^2hK/kcal], is the sum of the resistances of a building element to the transmission of heat (thermal resistances and surface resistances): 1/U = R_{si} + R + R_{se}

title: 平屋面排水坡度
summary: 坡度不超过 5% 的屋面为平屋面；无坡平屋面只在例外情况下作为特殊构造；平屋面一般至少 2% 坡度，考虑平整度误差和挠度建议至少 5%（3°）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: What minimum slope should a flat roof generally have, and what minimum slope is recommended to allow for unavoidable flatness tolerances and deflection?
answer: Generally min. 2%; recommended min. 5% (3°)

basis.quote: Flat roofs are defined as roofs with a slope of up to 5%. Flat roofs without slope are possible as a special construction in exceptional cases. Flat roofs should generally have a minimum slope of 2%.
it is recommended to construct flat roofs with a minimum slope of 5% (3°).

title: 隔汽层设在暖侧
summary: 若隔汽层在外侧（冷侧），整个水蒸气压力梯度都发生在那里，会产生冷凝；要避免冷凝，须在暖侧设置隔汽层。较新的构造（暖屋面、暖立面）外侧有隔汽层（如防水层），因此另设内侧隔汽层。坡屋面中隔汽层位于保温层下方，以防屋面构造内部冷凝。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: To avoid condensation within a building element, on which side must the vapour barrier be installed?
answer: On the warm (interior) side

options: In the ventilated cavity outside the insulation
In the middle of the insulation layer

rubric: Vapour barrier on the warm side
A vapour barrier on the outside causes condensation because the whole vapour pressure gradient occurs there

basis.quote: If there is a vapour barrier on the outside, then the entire vapour pressure gradient occurs there and the result is condensation → 8; if this is to be avoided, then a vapour barrier must be installed on the warm side

title: 种植屋面的坡度
summary: 种植的坡屋面坡度不应超过 25°，种植平屋面坡度最大 2–3%。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For roofs with planting (green roofs), what maximum pitch should a gabled roof have, and what maximum slope should a planted flat roof have?
answer: Gabled roof max. 25°; flat roof max. 2–3%

basis.quote: The pitch of gabled roofs should not exceed 25° and flat roofs should have a maximum slope of 2–3%.

title: 坡屋面保温位置与通风构造
summary: 坡屋面保温一般为矿棉卷材，铺在椽间和椽下，室内侧设隔汽层；通风屋面在挂瓦下垫层与保温之间另有通风层，需更大椽高且只有在隔汽层和通风都可靠时才有效，因此业内多采用非通风构造。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Why does the building industry commonly prefer unventilated over ventilated insulated pitched-roof construction?
answer: Ventilated roofs need additional rafter depth and only work properly with a correctly installed vapour barrier and functioning roof ventilation
accept: Ventilated roofs need additional rafter depth and only work properly with a correctly installed vapour barrier and functioning roof ventilation

options: Unventilated roofs allow insulation only above the rafters
Unventilated roofs need no vapour barrier
Ventilated roofs are not permitted under the energy saving regulation
Ventilated roofs need deeper rafters and depend on a correct vapour barrier and airflow

rubric: Depends on correctly installed vapour barrier and working ventilation

basis.quote: Ventilated roofs require additional rafter depth and work properly only with a correctly installed vapour barrier and functioning roof ventilation. Therefore the building industry commonly prefers unventilated roof construction.

title: 分户墙隔声
summary: 住宅之间或户与户之间的分户墙宜始终达到至少 400 kg/m² 的面密度。对于贯通整栋房屋进深设分隔缝的（房屋之间的）双叶分户墙：每叶（含抹灰）面密度须至少 150 kg/m²，分隔缝至少 30 mm；缝宽大于 50 mm 时每叶可为 100 kg/m²；缝腔内须满铺无缝的纤维隔声板。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For sound insulation, party walls between flats or houses should always have a mass per unit area of at least how much?
answer: 400 kg/m²

basis.quote: for this reason, party walls between flats or houses should always weigh at least 400 kg/m².

title: 模数协调与标志尺寸
summary: 基本模数 M = 100 mm，扩大模数 3M = 300 mm、6M = 600 mm、12M = 1200 mm；构造（标志）尺寸由模数尺寸扣除或加上灰缝/面层厚度得到，如砖模数长 25 cm、灰缝 1 cm、标志尺寸 24 cm，现浇混凝土墙 25 cm。
question: In the modular coordination system for building dimensions (DIN 18000, metric modular system), what is the basic module M, and which multi-modules are defined?
answer: M = 100 mm; multi-modules 3M, 6M and 12M

basis.quote: The units of the modular system are the basic module M = 100 mm and the multi-modules 3 M = 300 mm, 6 M = 600 mm and 12 M = 1200 mm.

title: 建筑等级与承重墙耐火
summary: （书中在垃圾间规定处以括号注明）住宅超过两套或使用面积达 400 m² 的建筑属于建筑等级 3–5。承重及支撑墙、柱在等级 5 的建筑中须为防火（耐火）构造，等级 4 须为高度阻燃，等级 1 和 2 须为阻燃；此规定不适用于其上方无居室的屋顶空间最上层及阳台；在地下室中须为防火构造，等级 1 和 2 的建筑为阻燃。
question: Under the German model building code building classes, what fire-resistance quality must load-bearing and bracing walls and columns (above ground) have in building class 5, in class 4, and in classes 1–2?
answer: Class 5: fireproof (fire-resistant); class 4: highly fire-retarding; classes 1–2: fire-retarding

options: Class 5: highly fire-retarding; class 4: fire-retarding; classes 1–2: no requirement
Class 5: fire-retarding; class 4: highly fire-retarding; classes 1–2: fireproof
Class 5: fireproof; class 4: fireproof; classes 1–2: highly fire-retarding
Class 5: fireproof; class 4: highly fire-retarding; classes 1–2: fire-retarding

basis.quote: Load-bearing and bracing walls and columns must be constructed fireproof in buildings of class 5, highly fire-retarding in buildings of class 4 and fire-retarding in buildings of classes 1 and 2

title: 住宅/商业单元之间的分隔墙
summary: 居住或商业单元之间（或单元与其他用途房间之间）分隔墙的耐火时间须与该层承重构件相当，并须一直砌到结构楼板（屋顶空间内到屋面覆层）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For separating walls between residential or commercial units, what fire resistance duration is required and how far up must the walls extend?
answer: Fire resistance corresponding to the load-bearing components of that storey; extending up to the structural slab (in roof spaces up to the roof cladding)
accept: Fire resistance corresponding to the load-bearing components of that storey; extending up to the structural slab (in roof spaces up to the roof cladding)

options: Fire resistance equal to the storey's load-bearing components; up to the structural slab (in roof spaces to the roof cladding)
Always 30 minutes; up to the suspended ceiling
Always 90 minutes; up to the underside of the roof insulation
Fire resistance equal to the storey's load-bearing components; up to the suspended ceiling

rubric: Fire resistance matches that of the storey's load-bearing components
Must extend to the structural slab; in roof spaces to the roof cladding

basis.quote: The fire resistance duration of separating walls between residential or commercial units (or units and rooms used otherwise) must correspond to the quality of the load-bearing components of the storey. These must extend to the structural slab (in roof spaces up to the roof cladding).

title: 外墙及外墙饰面的燃烧性能
summary: 非承重外墙及承重外墙的非承重部分（建筑等级 1–3 除外）须用不燃（至少阻燃）材料建造；外墙饰面（含保温层及支撑构造）须用难燃材料；等级 1、2 的建筑如能有效防止火势蔓延至相邻建筑，允许外墙饰面采用普通可燃材料。
question: Under German building regulations, for buildings other than those of building classes 1 and 2 (and below high-rise level), what minimum fire behaviour must the materials of external wall claddings, including insulation and support construction, have?
answer: Flame-resistant (schwer entflammbar)
rubric: Exception: classes 1 and 2 may use normally flammable materials if fire spread to neighbours is prevented

basis.quote: For buildings of classes 1 and 2, external wall claddings of normally flammable materials are permissible, if the spread of fire to neighbouring buildings is effectively prevented.
External wall claddings, including insulation and support construction, have to be made of flame-resistant materials.

title: 立面竖梃与隔墙的连接
summary: 位于模数网格上的立面竖向型材应有足够宽度以连接隔墙；更好的做法是沿立面设置隔声型材；须注意窗的开启扇。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: What requirement applies to the vertical profiles of an office façade that lie on the modular grid?
answer: They should be wide enough to connect a partition
accept: wide enough for a partition wall to connect

options: At most 50 mm wide to maximise daylight
Set back at least 20 cm behind the columns
Wide enough to connect a partition
Thermally broken and at least F 30

rubric: Profiles on the grid wide enough to connect a partition

basis.quote: Vertical profiles in the façade, which lie on the modular grid, should be wide enough to connect a partition.

title: 轻质隔墙的隔声与上下延续
summary: 轻质隔墙的节点要特别注意隔声；采用架空地板和吊顶时，要么让隔墙在竖向上延续，要么这些构件本身须具备隔声性能。
question: In German (DIN-based) office design practice: Where light partitions are combined with raised access floors and suspended ceilings, what must be provided to prevent sound transfer above and below the partitions?
answer: Either the partitions are continued vertically (through floor void and ceiling void), or these elements are sound-insulating in themselves
accept: vertical continuation of the partitions, or sound-insulating floor/ceiling elements

options: Carpet throughout and acoustic plaster on the walls
Vertical continuation of the partitions, or floor and ceiling elements that are sound-insulating in themselves
Double partitions with 40 mm mineral wool only
A 10 cm air gap above every partition

rubric: or sound-insulating raised floor / suspended ceiling elements

title: 高层外窗的清洁
